campaign_name: PR-EG-R2C-R1 — Conversational Topic Grounding & Authorized Recall
purpose: Focused implementation and qualification; stop after R2C-R1 and await external review.
executive_summary:
**C — REPAIR INCOMPLETE.** Topic selection ranks relevant authorized authored topics after speaker and answer-sufficiency checks. Immediate repetition and subject-specific historical lookup use actual delivered speech. GM recall retains attribution. The existing R2C host-owned adoption and rejected-candidate exclusion remain in force.

Combined regression: {'passed': 550, 'failed': 26} before; {'passed': 584, 'failed': 25} after. No existing expectation was changed. Newly failing: []. R2C H6 now passes unchanged; the original 19 failures and 6 additional inherited owner-suite failures remain.

Final fresh-provider production /api/chat: 15 primary + 12 secondary turns, 2 failing turns. Relevance/authority/history/state checks: 25/27. 14 provider calls, 0 narration calls, 0 retries. Independent holdouts: 15/15, including four final-revision independent cases.

Qualification is bounded to these fictional scenes and the configured provider route. The existing delivered-history store is capped at 32 records; this is not unlimited campaign memory or arbitrary semantic understanding. Stop after PR-EG-R2C-R1; await external review before R3.

production: Repair existing topic selection, delivered-reference grounding and authorized recall in three modules; preserve R2C adoption.
validation: T01–T28 and five additional controls; unchanged historical H6; independent frozen holdouts.
tooling: Cycle-specific fresh HTTP runner and evidence/review builders.
generated_artifacts: Exact baseline/final identities, failed/final live transcripts, source hashes/diffs and state/performance audits.

testing.focused: T01–T28 plus five additional controls pass; unchanged H6 passes.
testing.full_suite: Not run; combined relevant family only.
testing.runtime_validation: Two final fresh production HTTP conversations (15 + 12 turns): primary fails turns 7/8; secondary passes. Relevance/authority audited.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: Configured gpt-4.1-mini; real interpretation provider, no live doubles or replay.

campaign_specific: Final primary direct guard question is blocked by upstream unresolved subject reference; its immediate follow-up lacks the requested disclosure. Repeated live failure triggers the stop condition.
Bounded lexical subject matching, 32-row history cap, controlled multi-speaker qualification only.
Initial D/F short probes passed; extended frozen-baseline reproduction executed later.
pre_existing: 25 combined-family inherited failures; exact identities in report 14.

missing_concepts: Unlimited historical memory and arbitrary semantic paraphrase qualification are outside this cycle.
decisions_requiring_human_review: External review of R2C-R1 closure readiness and all preserved failed transcripts.
does_not_prove: All repository tests passing, arbitrary generated-speech safety, unlimited recall, process-restart persistence or R3 readiness.
recommended_next_step: Stop after PR-EG-R2C-R1: live qualification fails. Await external review of the upstream reference-eligibility blocker; do not proceed to R3.
